mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_subscription (endpoint, p256dh, auth, user_id, email) VALUES (#{endpoint}, #{p256dh}, #{auth}, #{userId}, #{email}) ON CONFLICT (endpoint) DO UPDATE SET p256dh = EXCLUDED.p256dh, auth = EXCLUDED.auth, user_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.user_id, push_subscription.user_id), email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.email, push_subscription.email)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM push_subscription ORDER BY added_at DESC
SELECT * FROM push_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY added_at DESC
SELECT * FROM push_subscription WHERE lower(email) = lower(#{email}) ORDER BY added_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM push_subscription WHERE last_delivered_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE push_subscription SET last_delivered_at = #{now} WHERE endpoint = #{endpoint}
UPDATE push_subscription SET last_sent_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
